description:
After a long day, high schooler Shintarou Tokumitsu’s plans for relaxing in his studio apartment take a turn when he discovers an angel on his balcony. The divine girl, Towa, reveals she’s there to study humanity, and yet despite his skepticism, he agrees to put her up. Prepare for the most heavenly and high jinks roommate experience of all time!

(Source: Crunchyroll)

node.description: An angel who came from heaven to study humans. She moves into [Shintarou's](https://anilist.co/character/316296/) apartment and they start living together. She has a kind and humble personality, but is ignorant of the circumstances of the human world. When she gets excited, her angel wings accidentally pop out.

[Shintarou's](https://anilist.co/character/316296/) classmate who works at the same family restaurant. When she closed her heart in order to hide her identity, she was rumored to be the "Ice Queen" due to her cool appearance.

~!She is actually a yuki onna and when she gets emotional, she causes a blizzard.!~

[Shintarou's](https://anilist.co/character/316296/) classmate who works at a maid cafe. She is a full-on vampire who wears an eyepatch, bandage, and colored contact lenses. She likes Shintarou's "scent" and tries to "hook up" him whenever she gets a chance. Her real name is Sayuri Kagami. She belongs to the occult research club.

[Shintarou's](https://anilist.co/character/316296/) classmate. She fell in love with him when they were both children and they had a fateful reunion in high school. Even now, she continues to hold an unrequited love for him, but every day she feels daunted by the unique girls around him. She is good at studying and cooking.

[Lilishka's](https://anilist.co/character/320699/) classmate and another member of the occult research club. She is shy, and because she grew up surrounded by women, she has trouble talking to boys. She is actually the daughter of a wealthy family, and she is a kappa who is the granddaughter of the president of the All Japan Kappa Federation. Her hobby is reading.

He started living on his own when he entered high school due to his parents' work commitments. He is a caring and kind person who is considerate towards everyone and notices the good in others. He's a perfectly normal high school student, but he's the type you can rely on in an emergency.
